events.text: The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) confirms that they have killed three militants in separate strikes last week, including a Jaish al-Islam militant in Gaza City, a Hamas commander in the Jabalya Battalion, and a Palestinian Islamic Jihad mili
The IDF's 401st Brigade says that they have destroyed 1,200 Hezbollah tunnels and concluded their mission in southern Lebanon, ending their eight-month deployment.
A drone strike hits a customary court in Kabkabiya District, North Darfur, Sudan, killing at least 37 people.
The BBC reports that Russia has shipped military equipment on the sanctioned cargo vessel Mikhail Britnev last month.
Two people are killed when two firefighting helicopters collided near Athens, Greece.
Six people are killed and 27 more injured in a traffic collision between a bus, a camper and three cars in Colli sul Velino, Province of Rieti, Italy.
A ferry catches fire off the coast of Madura, Indonesia, leaving at least five people dead and 41 others missing.
South Korea's weather agency records {{convert|42.5|C|F}} in Yangsan, South Gyeongsang, the country's highest temperature since observations began.

events.text: The Dominican Republic and Venezuela agree on a framework to gradually restore diplomatic relations, which deteriorated after the Dominican Republic questioned the results of the 2024 Venezuelan presidential election.
